name: Cin-Cin Wine Bar & Restaurant
list: Where the tech deals are made
note: SFGate says Cin-Cin is a favorite haunt of Google, Apple, Netflix, Cisco and eBay staff and is co-owned by Google's first marketing director.

name: Joanie's Cafe
note: Culture Trip says VC partners frequently hold breakfast meetings with startup founders at Joanie's Cafe on California Avenue.

name: Woodside Bakery
note: Culture Trip says Woodside Bakery is filled with people talking about angel funding and venture capital.

name: Flea Street
note: SFGate says Mark Zuckerberg met Sheryl Sandberg at Flea Street when recruiting her to Facebook and Sand Hill Road venture capitalists are among its clientele.

name: Tamarine Restaurant
note: Fortune reports Apple CEO Tim Cook and Google CEO Sundar Pichai were seen having a private dinner at Tamarine.
